name: WR1-Absorption (measured)
mechanism_text: When WR1 misses a game, his vacated target share does NOT transfer wholesale. WR2 absorbs ~+0.7pp (+13.5% lift on his baseline 5.19% share), WR3 ~+0.7pp (+15.6%); the majority of WR1's ~9.7% share disperses to TEs, RBs, and checkdown targets. The market's naive 1.2-1.3x scaling of WR2 lines overstates the effect.

magnitude_ladder.mag: WR2 line x1.135, WR3 x1.156 — the measured multiplier, not the folk 1.25x
partial weight by P(active); recompute at the freshness-stamped report

magnitude_ladder.condition: WR1 out AND WR2 also out
magnitude_ladder.mag: NOT measured in this run — named gap; WR3 becomes the floor but the dispersion target is unmeasured

falsifiers: a season split where WR2 lift exceeds +25% (the dispersion pattern changed)
team-level heterogeneity: if per-team lifts vary >2x, the pooled multiplier is wrong and per-team rates are required
composes_with: Depth-Chart Replacement (the promotion-side mirror of the same vacancy mechanism)
Route-Depth Signature (the promoted WR2's kinematic profile determines which routes he inherits)
use_in_decision: SHADOW weight 0; the x1.135/x1.156 multipliers are the measured location adjustment for the prop margin's injury-conditioned variant
anti_template: replaces the folk 'WR1 out = WR2 feast' scaling the market and models often embed
